title: The 10 Best Car Battery Chargers and Maintainers
subtitle: Smart battery chargers and maintainers for cars, trucks, motorcycles, boats and mowers, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A smart battery charger refills a flat battery and then holds it at full charge without overcharging. We ranked 10 best-sellers from NOCO, Battery Tender, Schumacher, CTEK and MOTOPOWER on rating, review volume and features (4 A or more charging, lithium support, a 5-year or longer warranty and 6V support). Pick the amps for the battery: small for bikes and mowers, bigger for cars and trucks.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: NOCO GENIUS5 5A 6/12V Smart Battery Charger, Trickle Charger and Maintainer

specs.chemistry: Lead-acid (AGM, Gel, SLA, VRLA) and lithium (LiFePO4)

products.verdict: The all-rounder: 5 amps is enough to charge a flat car battery overnight and gentle enough to maintain one all winter. It handles lead-acid and lithium, 6V and 12V, and adjusts for temperature.
products.best_for: Most drivers: charging and maintaining a car, truck, boat or motorcycle battery.
products.skip_if: You need to jump-start a car; it has no engine-start mode.

products.name: NOCO GENIUS1 1A 6/12V Smart Battery Charger, Trickle Charger and Maintainer
products.verdict: The best-selling and most-reviewed charger here: a small 1-amp maintainer for keeping a stored car, motorcycle, mower or boat battery topped up, lithium included.
products.best_for: Keeping a stored vehicle's battery healthy over winter.
products.skip_if: Your battery is dead; 1 A takes a very long time to recharge a car battery.

products.name: Battery Tender Junior 12V 750mA Charger and Maintainer
products.verdict: The classic motorcycle and powersports maintainer, rated 4.8 stars on almost 50,000 reviews, with a ring-terminal harness you leave on the bike and a 5-year warranty.
products.best_for: Motorcycles, ATVs and mowers that sit for weeks.
products.skip_if: You need lithium charging or a 6V battery.

products.name: Battery Tender Plus 12V 1.25 AMP Car and Motorcycle Battery Charger and Maintainer
products.verdict: A slightly stronger Battery Tender for cars and bikes in storage, with a 4-step program and a 10-year warranty, the longest here.
products.best_for: Keeping a stored car or bike battery healthy for years.

products.name: Schumacher Electric 15A Car Battery Charger and Maintainer, 6V/12V (SC1280)

specs.extras: Desulfation, battery tester, auto voltage detection

products.verdict: A 15-amp charger that brings a dead car battery back in hours, with desulfation and a battery test mode, then drops to a smart trickle to maintain it.

products.name: Schumacher Electric 1.5A Car Battery Charger and Maintainer, 6V/12V (SC1355)
products.verdict: A cheap 1.5-amp maintainer from Schumacher with desulfation and automatic 6V/12V detection.

products.name: CTEK MXS 5.0 Fully Automatic 4.3 Amp Battery Charger and Maintainer, 12V (40-206)
products.verdict: A premium 8-step charger from CTEK with a reconditioning mode, built to charge marine, car and bike batteries in all conditions.

specs.extras: Pulse desulfation, zero standby drain, spark-proof

products.verdict: A charger with a 100-amp engine start to crank a car on a dead battery, a 30-amp boost and a smart 2-6 A trickle.

products.skip_if: You just maintain a stored battery.

avoid.name: Car Battery Charger Battery Maintainer for Automatic Trickle Charger
avoid.flag: Says it supports AGM, then says no float charge for AGM
avoid.verdict: A cheap charger whose listing contradicts itself on which batteries it can maintain, the one job a maintainer has.
reasons: It lists AGM batteries as supported, then says '(NO floating charge for AGM batteries)', so it can't hold an AGM battery at full charge in storage.
The listing says it's for '6A and 12V' batteries, mixing up amps and volts.
The NOCO GENIUS1 costs about $8 more, handles lead-acid and lithium, and has 63,683 reviews.

buyers_guide.a: A charger refills a flat battery; a maintainer (or 'tender') holds a full battery at the right voltage while it sits. Low-amp units (0.75 to 1.5 A) are maintainers. 5 A and up can charge a dead car battery overnight. Most smart chargers do both.

buyers_guide.q: How many amps do I need?
buyers_guide.a: For a motorcycle or mower, 1 A. For a car you drive, 4 to 6 A charges in a night. For trucks, boats and RVs, 10 A or more. Bigger isn't better for small batteries; follow the battery maker's limit.

Only if it has a lithium mode. NOCO's GENIUS chargers and some Battery Tender models do; most Schumacher and CTEK models here are lead-acid and AGM only. Charging lithium on a lead-acid profile can damage it.

buyers_guide.q: Is it safe to leave connected all winter?
buyers_guide.a: That's what smart maintainers are for: they switch to a float or pulse mode once the battery is full. Old-style 'trickle' chargers without automatic shutoff can overcharge.
It pulses the battery to break down sulfate crystals that build up when a lead-acid battery sits discharged. It can help a weak battery; it won't revive one with a dead cell.
